_comment: battle_forms: a rule per class. strikes[i] is strike i of the battle: form = the class to fight as (an id or a new class key), attack = the attack id (content-dump/attacks.json lists them). A strike without a form keeps the class; one without an attack uses the form's attack for its row. attacks = the strikes in a battle.

strikes._note: Tiamat, Rotten Breath (0x25) from any row
